name: test_llm_selector_openai_models_are_available_and_functional
description:
The 4 present OpenAI models are listed in the LLM selector, each
        can be selected + saved (201 on the Save PUT), and each produces a
        "CONFIRMED" response in the embedded chat, correctly attributed to
        the selected model. GPT-4.1 (case-named, absent from the live
        catalog) is deliberately not exercised — see module docstring.

steps.name: Precondition — create a dedicated disposable agent
Step 1 — Navigate to agent detail page
Step 2 — Click the model selector dropdown
Step 3 — Verify all four present OpenAI models are listed in the dropdown
Step 4-6 — Select 'GPT-5 mini', save, and verify the chat response contains "CONFIRMED"
Step 7 — Select 'GPT-5.2', save, and verify the chat response contains "CONFIRMED"
Step 9 — Select 'GPT-5.4', save, and verify the chat response contains "CONFIRMED"
Step 10 — Select 'GPT-5.4-mini', save, and verify the chat response contains "CONFIRMED"
Verify no console errors or warnings across the full flow
